prompts.grass: Generate a new square seamless texture source for a 90-degree top-down forest-floor game. PHYSICAL SCALE: the entire image represents an EIGHT METRE by EIGHT METRE patch of ground. This is a high resolution source which will be reduced to 256x256 game pixels (32 pixels per metre). Very short fine woodland grass blades 5–15 CENTIMETRES long, small loosely grouped tufts 15–35 CENTIMETRES across, many tiny varied growth directions, scattered bare moist soil between grass. This is NOT long meadow grass: no sweeping long strings, no tall stalks, no large star-shaped tussocks, no large objects. Grass occupies around 65 percent of the ground, low flat sparse growth merging into dark green mossy soil; calm uniform overall density with small irregular bare gaps. Rich local material shapes with subtle olive and cool desaturated green, dark forest ambience, even diffuse lighting without shadows, no broad noise clouds, no vignette, no perspective. Direct vertical orthographic overhead, flat 2D painterly-realistic game texture. Opposite edges must tile seamlessly. Do not depict grass blades longer than 15cm; short modest strokes and tiny clusters, predominantly dark moss green and brown-green. No flowers, shrubs, stones, fog, paths, outlines, text or UI. Material reference: a natural cohesive dark woodland floor with readable tiny detail and quiet larger-scale variation.
prompts.earth: Generate a new square seamless texture SOURCE for a dark forest-floor 2D game. PHYSICAL SCALE: the entire square represents EIGHT METRES by EIGHT METRES of soil, and will be reduced to 256x256 game pixels (32 pixels per metre). Fine compacted dark brown forest earth with minute grain and heterogeneous small crumbs, most aggregates 1–3 CENTIMETRES and a few tiny pebbles only 2–5 CENTIMETRES. Sparse crushed leaf fragments 3–8cm and slender twig splinters, mostly plain compacted loam. This is NOT gravel, no cobblestones, no large lumps, no large stones or giant leaves. Material needs coherent fine local structure with quiet overall value, weak uneven moist/dry variation, subtle dark desaturated warm browns, not reddish orange. The eye should read finely textured soil, with occasional tiny organic inclusions. Orthographic 90-degree overhead, all ground at one plane, flat diffuse illumination, painterly-realistic game art, no shadows, edges, noise overlays, sharpening, paths, grass, objects, fog, labels or vignette. Seamlessly tileable on both axes.
